rate.carrierHint: Sendcloud code, e.g. inpost_es or ups. Required for pickup points: it filters the points offered.
rate.optionCodeHint: Empty: the label is made by hand.
rate.transitHint: Shown under the method, e.g. “1–2 days”.

fieldErrors.GROUPING_SEPARATOR: Remove the thousands separator: enter 1234 rather than 1,234.
fieldErrors.TOO_LARGE: That is larger than the system allows.
fieldErrors.BOUNDS_ORDER: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
fieldErrors.NOT_POSITIVE: It must be greater than zero; leave it empty for no free shipping.
fieldErrors.TRANSIT_ORDER: The maximum transit cannot be less than the minimum.
fieldErrors.CARRIER_REQUIRED: A pickup point needs a carrier: without one no points can be searched.
fieldErrors.INVALID_CARRIER: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, e.g. inpost_es.
fieldErrors.COUNTRY_TAKEN: Some countries already belong to another zone.

reasons.COUNTRY_IN_OTHER_ZONE: One of the countries already belongs to another zone (someone may have just saved it). Reload the page to see the current zones.
reasons.TAX_RATE_MISSING: One of the countries has no VAT rate configured, so its shipping could not be charged. Ask for that country's VAT to be set up before adding it.
reasons.INVALID_BOUNDS: The limits are inconsistent: the minimum must be lower than the maximum, and a flat rate takes no limits.
reasons.INVALID_TRANSIT_DAYS: The maximum transit cannot be less than the minimum.
reasons.SERVICE_POINT_NEEDS_CARRIER: A pickup-point rate needs a carrier.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the form: the server rejected these details.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account is not allowed to manage shipping.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This zone or rate no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT: The change conflicts with the current state. Reload the page and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.PAYMENT_FAILED: The payment service refused the operation.
errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed while you were saving.
errors.ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION: That change is not allowed in the current state.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Server error. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.UNPARSEABLE_RESPONSE: The server sent something this dashboard does not understand. The API and dashboard versions may have diverged.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reason.SERVICE_POINT_REQUIRED: This shipping method needs a pickup point.
reason.SERVICE_POINT_NOT_ALLOWED: This shipping method delivers to the door; it takes no pickup point.
reason.SERVICE_POINT_UNAVAILABLE: The pickup point is no longer available.
reason.FULFILMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sendcloud is not configured on this environment.

reason.LABEL_NOT_AVAILABLE: There is no stored label to print or download.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the label?
cancelDialog.consequence: It is voided in Sendcloud and credited if the carrier has not scanned it yet. The order goes back to “Paid” so another can be generated.

fulfilment.labelError: We could not open the label: {reason}

resetPassword.title: Choose a password

verifyEmail.title: Verifying your email

verifyEmail.missingToken: The verification code is missing from the link.
